briefings.title: Treasury counselor David Zervos: I'm very skeptical that inflation is running amok
briefings.tldr: Treasury Counselor David Zervos pushed back against fears of runaway inflation, arguing that recent price pressures stem from a temporary energy supply shock and a one-off 0.5% tariff hit, while attributing last week's sharp market sell-off to a mix of Fed policy confusion, election shifts, and a lack of clarity around Nvidia.
